Axis.summary: Direction of the **X** axis of the attachment, represented as a unit `Datatype.Vector3`.

Orientation.summary: Orientation of the attachment relative to the orientation of its parent.

Position.summary: Positional offset of the attachment, relative to the position and orientation of its parent.

Rotation.summary: Rotation of the attachment relative to the rotation of its parent.

SecondaryAxis.summary: Direction of the **Y** axis of the attachment, represented as a unit `Datatype.Vector3`.

Visible.summary: Toggles the in-experience visibility of the attachment.

WorldAxis.summary: Direction of the **X** axis of the attachment relative to the world, represented as a unit `Datatype.Vector3` with a length of 1.

WorldCFrame.summary: The exact `Datatype.CFrame` of the attachment in world space coordinates.

WorldOrientation.summary: Orientation of the attachment relative to the world rather than its own parent.

WorldPosition.summary: Position of the attachment relative to the world rather than its own parent.

WorldRotation.summary: Rotation of the attachment relative to the world rather than its own parent.

WorldSecondaryAxis.summary: Direction of the **Y** axis of the attachment relative to the world, represented as a unit `Datatype.Vector3` with a length of 1.

Brightness.summary: Scales the light emitted from the beam when `Class.Beam.LightInfluence|LightInfluence` is less than 1.

Color.summary: Determines the color of the beam across its `Class.Beam.Segments|Segments`.

CurveSize0.summary: Determines, along with `Class.Beam.Attachment0|Attachment0`, the position of the second control point in the beam's Bézier curve.

CurveSize1.summary: Determines, along with `Class.Beam.Attachment1|Attachment1`, the position of the third control point in the beam's Bézier curve.

Enabled.summary: Determines whether the beam is visible or not.

FaceCamera.summary: Determines whether the `Class.Beam.Segments|Segments` of the beam will always face the camera, regardless of its orientation.

LightEmission.summary: Determines to what degree the colors of the beam are blended with the colors behind it.

LightInfluence.summary: Determines the degree to which the beam is influenced by the environment's lighting.

LocalTransparencyModifier.summary: Determines a multiplier for `Class.Beam.Transparency` that is only visible to the local client.

Segments.summary: Sets how many straight segments the beam is made up of.

Texture.summary: The content ID of the texture to be displayed on the beam.

TextureContent.summary: The texture displayed on the beam. Supports [asset URIs](../../../projects/assets/index.md#asset-uris).

TextureLength.summary: Sets the length of the beam's texture, dependent on `Class.Beam.TextureMode|TextureMode`.

TextureMode.summary: Determines the manner in which the `Class.Beam.Texture|Texture` scales and repeats.

TextureSpeed.summary: Determines the speed at which the `Class.Beam.Texture|Texture` image moves along the beam.

Transparency.summary: Determines the transparency of the beam across its segments.

Width0.summary: The width of the beam at its origin (`Class.Beam.Attachment0|Attachment0`), in studs.

Width1.summary: The width of the beam at its end (`Class.Beam.Attachment1|Attachment1`), in studs.

ZOffset.summary: The distance, in studs, the beam display is offset relative to the `Class.Workspace.CurrentCamera|CurrentCamera`.

Archivable.summary: Determines if an `Class.Instance` and its descendants can be cloned using `Class.Instance:Clone()`, and can be saved/published.

Parent.summary: Determines the hierarchical parent of the `Class.Instance`.

Brightness.summary: Sets how bright the emitted light is, defaults to 1.

Color.summary: The color of the emitted light.

Enabled.summary: If set to true, light will be emitted from the source object.

Shadows.summary: If set to true, will project shadows if light is blocked by an obstacle.

Acceleration.summary: Determines the global-axis acceleration of all active particles, measured in studs per second squared.

Brightness.summary: Scales the light emitted from the emitter when `Class.ParticleEmitter.LightInfluence` is 0.

Color.summary: Determines the color of all active particles over their individual lifetimes.

Drag.summary: Determines the rate at which particles will lose half their speed through exponential decay.

EmissionDirection.summary: Determines the face of the object that particles emit from.

Enabled.summary: Determines if particles emit from the emitter.

FlipbookBlendFrames.summary: Determines whether the flipbook frames are blended between.

FlipbookFramerate.summary: Determines how fast the flipbook texture animates in frames per second.

FlipbookIncompatible.summary: The error message to display if the `Class.ParticleEmitter.Texture|Texture` is incompatible for a flipbook.

FlipbookLayout.summary: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture. Must be None, Grid2x2, Grid4x4, Grid8x8 or Custom.

FlipbookMode.summary: Determines the type of the flipbook animation. Must be Loop, OneShot, PingPong, or Random.

FlipbookSizeX.summary: Defines the number of horizontal frames in a custom flipbook layout.

FlipbookSizeY.summary: Defines the number of vertical frames in a custom flipbook layout.

FlipbookStartRandom.summary: Determines whether the animation starts at a random frame chosen per particle instead of always starting at frame zero.

Lifetime.summary: Defines a random range of ages for newly emitted particles.

LightEmission.summary: Determines how much particles' colors are blended with the colors behind them.

LightInfluence.summary: Determines how much particles are influenced by the environmental light.

LocalTransparencyModifier.summary: Determines a multiplier for `Class.ParticleEmitter.Transparency` that is only visible to the local client.

LockedToPart.summary: Determines whether the particles rigidly move with the part they're being emitted from.

Rate.summary: Determines the number of particles emitted per second.

RotSpeed.summary: Determines the range of angular speeds of emitted particles, measured in degrees per second.

Rotation.summary: Determines the range of rotations in degrees for newly emitted particles.

Shape.summary: Sets the shape of the emitter to either a box, sphere, cylinder, or disc.

ShapeInOut.summary: Sets whether particles emit outward only, inward only, or in both directions.

ShapePartial.summary: Influences particle emission from cylinder, disc, sphere, and box shapes.

ShapeStyle.summary: Sets particle emission to either volumetric or surface-only emission.

Size.summary: Determines the world size over individual particles' lifetimes.

Speed.summary: Determines a random range of velocities (minimum to maximum) at which new particles will emit, measured in studs per second.

SpreadAngle.summary: Determines the angles at which particles may be randomly emit, measured in degrees.

Squash.summary: Allows for non-uniform scaling of particles, curve-controlled over their lifetime.

Texture.summary: Determines the image rendered on particles.

TextureContent.summary: The image rendered on particles. Supports [asset URIs](../../../projects/assets/index.md#asset-uris).

TimeScale.summary: Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.

Transparency.summary: Determines the transparency of particles over their individual lifetimes.

VelocityInheritance.summary: Determines how much of the parent's velocity is inherited by particles when emitted.

VelocitySpread.summary: Determines how offset a particle can be fired from the local emitter direction of its parent.

WindAffectsDrag.summary: Whether emitted particles follow the `Class.Workspace.GlobalWind` vector.

ZOffset.summary: Determines the forward-backward render position of particles; used to control what particles render on top/bottom.

Range.summary: The size of the area that the PointLight will illuminate.

Attachment0.summary: Along with `Class.Trail.Attachment1|Attachment1`, determines where the trail will start drawing its segments.

Attachment1.summary: Along with `Class.Trail.Attachment0|Attachment0`, determines where the trail will start drawing its segments.

Brightness.summary: Scales the light emitted from the trail when `Class.Trail.LightInfluence|LightInfluence` is less than 1.

Color.summary: The color of the trail throughout its lifetime.

Enabled.summary: Determines whether the trail will be drawn or not.

FaceCamera.summary: Determines whether the trail will always face the camera, regardless of its orientation.

Lifetime.summary: Determines how long each segment in a trail will last, in seconds.

LightEmission.summary: Determines to what degree the colors of the trail are blended with the colors behind it.

LightInfluence.summary: Determines the degree to which the trail is influenced by the environment's lighting.

LocalTransparencyModifier.summary: Determines a multiplier for `Class.Trail.Transparency` that is only visible to the local client.

MaxLength.summary: Sets the maximum length of the trail.

MinLength.summary: Sets the minimum length of the trail.

Texture.summary: The content ID of the texture to be displayed on the trail.

TextureContent.summary: The texture displayed on the trail. Supports [asset URIs](../../../projects/assets/index.md#asset-uris).

TextureLength.summary: Sets the length of the trail's texture, dependent on `Class.Trail.TextureMode|TextureMode`.

TextureMode.summary: Determines the manner in which the `Class.Trail.Texture|Texture` scales, repeats, and moves along with the trail's attachments.

Transparency.summary: Sets the transparency of the trail's segments over its `Class.Trail.Lifetime|Lifetime`.

WidthScale.summary: Scales the width of the trail over the course of its lifetime.
